mergedParams.userDescription: Animated color gradient background behind static text.

output.title: Animated Gradient Background with Static Text

prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic gradient background animation with smooth, continuous color transitions that flows like liquid behind static text. Think of this as a luxury brand video background - the gradient should slowly morph between 3-4 premium colors (deep purples, rich blues, warm golds) using a sine wave timing pattern. The text should remain perfectly still and legible, creating a striking contrast between the fluid background motion and the stable foreground. Use a BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' for the main wrapper, then layer an absolutely positioned gradient div with 'absolute inset-0' behind a TextAtom with 'relative z-10'. Apply a continuous rotation effect to the gradient using transform rotate (0 to 360 degrees) over the full duration, combined with scale animations (1 to 1.5 and back) to create organic movement. Add a subtle blur filter animation (0px to 8px) for depth.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with two children - background BaseLayout for gradient and TextAtom for text. Background uses containerProps.className: 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full' with a div containing gradient styles via containerProps.style. Apply generic keyframe effects array with opacity (for fade-in), rotate (0deg to 360deg), scale (1 to 1.5 to 1), and filter blur animations. Use ease-in-out easing for organic motion. Text uses className: 'relative z-10 text-white font-bold text-6xl' with text-shadow for readability. Consider using an internal effect preset for the gradient animation that can be reused. Duration should use fitDurationTo: 'parent' for continuous looping.

prompts.prompt: Design a high-energy, beat-driven gradient pulse effect where the background gradient responds to audio intensity. Picture a music visualizer meets typography design - the gradient should pulse and breathe with the audio track's bass frequencies. Start with a dark base gradient (black to dark blue) that brightens and expands on each beat, creating a rhythmic visual heartbeat. The static text should have a subtle glow that intensifies during peaks. Use waveform effects to sync the gradient's brightness and scale to audio bass levels. Structure with a BaseLayout using 'flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen' containing a background div and centered TextAtom. The gradient should use radial-gradient expanding from center, animated via transform scale based on audio intensity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Implement with BaseLayout container using containerProps.className: 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center'. Add background BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0' containing gradient div. Apply waveform effects with type: 'scale' and 'brightness' targeting bass frequencies (20-250Hz). Set sensitivity: 0.8 and threshold: 0.3 for responsive but controlled animation. TextAtom uses 'relative z-20 text-white text-7xl font-black' with text-shadow glow effect. Add internal effect preset 'beat-glow' for text that pulses opacity and text-shadow blur on beats. Use audio analysis API if available to fetch beat timestamps for precise synchronization. Consider adding a subtle shake effect on high-intensity beats.

prompts.prompt: Craft a minimalist, slow-burn gradient animation inspired by sunset timelapses. The gradient should transition through warm colors (coral, orange, pink, purple) mimicking a 'golden hour' progression. Think of this as a meditation app background - extremely slow, calming transitions that are barely perceptible but create a living, breathing backdrop. The text should be clean and modern, perhaps with a subtle drop shadow. Use CSS custom properties to define gradient stops and animate them individually for more control. Structure with a single BaseLayout containing both gradient background and text, using CSS blend modes for interesting color interactions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className: 'relative w-full h-full'. Use containerProps.style to define CSS variables for gradient colors (--color-1, --color-2, --color-3) and animate these via generic effects. Create smooth transitions using very long durations (10-15 seconds per color shift) with linear easing. Background div uses 'absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br' with dynamic gradient stops. TextAtom uses 'absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-white text-5xl font-light tracking-wider'. Apply mix-blend-mode: 'soft-light' or 'overlay' to text for color interaction. Consider using opacity animations on gradient layers (0.8 to 1) for breathing effect.

prompts.prompt: Build a retro-futuristic animated gradient with sharp angular transitions, inspired by 80s motion graphics and vaporwave aesthetics. Think neon grid backgrounds with diagonal gradient sweeps that slide across the screen in geometric patterns. The gradient should use bold, contrasting colors (hot pink, electric blue, neon green) with hard edges rather than smooth blends. Implement using multiple gradient layers that slide in different directions - one moving diagonally top-left to bottom-right, another moving horizontally. The text should have a retro glow effect and slight chromatic aberration. Use clip-path animations to create angular reveals of gradient sections.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Multiple BaseLayout layers: main container with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden', then 3-4 gradient layers with 'absolute inset-0'. Each gradient layer uses different linear-gradient angles (45deg, -45deg, 90deg) and translateX/translateY animations with staggered timing. Apply clip-path: polygon() animations for geometric reveals. TextAtom uses 'relative z-30 text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-blue-500 text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-widest'. Add text-shadow with multiple offsets for chromatic aberration: '2px 2px 0 #ff00ff, -2px -2px 0 #00ffff'. Use step() easing for retro digital feel on some animations.

prompts.prompt: Create an organic, blob-like gradient animation using SVG filters and CSS transforms, similar to lava lamp effects or fluid simulations. The gradient should appear to be a living organism, with colors that merge and separate like oil on water. Think of those satisfying liquid motion graphics - smooth, hypnotic, and constantly morphing. Use SVG turbulence filters combined with CSS transforms to create non-uniform distortions. The static text should appear to float above this liquid surface with a subtle reflection effect below it. Colors should transition between complementary pairs (blue/orange, purple/yellow) for maximum visual impact.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with SVG filter definitions in containerProps.children. Define feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap filters with animated baseFrequency values. Gradient background uses 'absolute inset-0' with multiple radial-gradient layers at different positions. Apply transform: rotate() and scale() with different speeds per layer (3s, 5s, 7s) for complex motion. Add filter: url(#turbulence) to gradient layers. TextAtom uses 'relative z-10 text-white text-6xl font-bold' with main text, plus duplicate TextAtom below with 'transform scale-y-[-1] opacity-30' for reflection. Use generic effects to animate turbulence baseFrequency (0.01 to 0.05) for evolving distortion.

prompts.prompt: Design a particle-based gradient effect where the background appears to be made of thousands of colored particles that flow and swirl like a galaxy. Think of this as a cosmic dust animation - particles should have individual colors that collectively form a gradient pattern. The movement should be hypnotic and three-dimensional, with particles moving at different speeds to create depth. Use multiple layers of CSS radial-gradients positioned absolutely to simulate particles, with each layer having different animation speeds and directions. The text should have a subtle outer glow as if illuminated by the particle field.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black'. Create 20-30 child BaseLayouts using repeatChildrenProps, each with 'absolute' positioning and small radial-gradient circles (10-50px). Use random positioning via childrenProps with computed top/left percentages. Apply generic effects for each particle: translateX (random -100% to 100%), translateY (random -50% to 50%), opacity (0.3 to 1 to 0.3), with staggered delays using index-based timing. Duration varies per layer (5s to 15s) for natural movement. TextAtom uses 'relative z-50 text-white text-7xl font-thin' with CSS filter: drop-shadow() for glow. Consider using internal effect preset 'particle-float' for reusable particle animation.

prompts.prompt: Implement a glitch-art inspired gradient with datamosh effects and color channel separations. Picture a corrupted video file aesthetic - the gradient should occasionally 'break' into RGB color channels that shift and misalign, then reform. Use sharp, digital transitions between gradient states with intentional 'errors' like color banding and pixelation effects. The animation should feel unstable but controlled, with moments of perfect clarity followed by chaotic transitions. Text should remain stable but occasionally flicker or shift slightly to maintain the glitch aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with three gradient layers for RGB channels. Each uses 'absolute inset-0 mix-blend-mode-screen' with red, green, blue gradients. Apply transform: translateX() offsets that occasionally separate (0px to 10px) then snap back. Use step() easing for digital feel. Add occasional scale glitches (1 to 1.02) with 0.1s duration. Include opacity flickers using generic effects with rapid keyframes (1, 0, 1) at specific times. TextAtom uses 'relative z-40 text-white font-mono text-6xl' with occasional translateX jitter effect (0 to 2px) using step easing. Consider adding scanline overlay using repeating-linear-gradient for CRT monitor effect.

prompts.prompt: Create a sophisticated mesh gradient animation inspired by Apple's design language - smooth, premium, and subtly dynamic. The gradient should use 4-5 color points that gently orbit around each other, creating ever-changing color combinations. Think of it as a 'breathing' background where colors ebb and flow like gentle waves. Use CSS radial-gradients at specific points that move in circular patterns. The movement should be so subtle it's almost subliminal, creating a sense of life without distraction. Text should be bold and minimal with perfect contrast.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Create 4-5 BaseLayout children for gradient points, each with 'absolute w-[800px] h-[800px] rounded-full' and radial-gradient from color to transparent. Position at different points (top: -200px, left: -200px, etc.). Apply circular motion using both translateX and translateY with sine/cosine patterns in generic effects. Use very slow duration (20-30s) with linear easing for smooth orbits. Add subtle scale animations (0.8 to 1.2) and opacity variations (0.6 to 1). Background base uses 'absolute inset-0 bg-gray-50'. TextAtom uses 'relative z-10 text-gray-900 text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight'. Consider blur filter on gradients for softer edges.

prompts.prompt: Build a cinematic 'northern lights' aurora effect with flowing gradient ribbons that dance across the screen. Imagine vertical curtains of light that wave and shimmer with ethereal colors (greens, purples, blues). The gradient should have a natural, wind-blown quality with varying opacity to simulate the aurora's characteristic transparency. Use multiple gradient layers with different wave patterns created through CSS transforms and clip-paths. The animation should feel majestic and otherworldly. Text should appear to be lit by the aurora with subtle color reflections.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-black via-gray-900 to-black'. Create 5-7 aurora ribbon layers using BaseLayout with 'absolute w-full h-[200%]' and linear-gradient(180deg) with multiple color stops. Apply transform: translateY() animations from -100% to 0% with different speeds (10s to 20s). Add skewY() transforms that animate from -5deg to 5deg for wave effect. Use clip-path: polygon() to create irregular ribbon shapes. Apply opacity animations (0.3 to 0.8) with overlap. TextAtom uses 'relative z-20 text-white text-7xl font-light' with animated text-shadow that cycles through aurora colors. Consider adding blur(2px) to distant layers for depth.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'liquid metal' gradient effect where colors flow like mercury or molten metal. The gradient should have a reflective, metallic quality with colors that pool and separate like immiscible liquids. Think T-1000 from Terminator - smooth, reflective surfaces that constantly reform. Use metallic color palettes (silver, gold, copper, bronze) with high contrast highlights. Implement using multiple gradient layers with different blend modes to create the metallic sheen. Add subtle 'ripple' effects that propagate across the surface. The text should appear engraved or embossed into the metal surface.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900'. Create base metallic layer with linear-gradient using metallic colors and hard stops for sharp reflections. Add 2-3 overlay layers with 'absolute inset-0 mix-blend-mode-overlay' using radial-gradients that move and morph. Apply transform: scale() from center point to create ripple effects, triggered at intervals. Use filter: contrast(1.2) brightness(1.1) for metallic sheen. Add specular highlight layer with small white radial-gradients that move across surface. TextAtom uses 'relative z-10 text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-200 to-gray-600 text-8xl font-black' for metallic text. Add text-shadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)' for embossed effect. Consider using internal effect preset for ripple propagation.
